Jon (AE): Heads up — BioLattice is blocking POC access. Procurement says they require an original wet-ink Order Form and an executed MSA with highlighted SLA concessions.

Maya (Procurement): They cited internal rule "ExecDocs-5". Do they accept a notarized scan while the original is couriered? We need the PO to match invoices.

Jon (AE): PO BL-90011. Customer told us notarized scan is OK if original arrives within 5 business days.

Priya (Legal): Hybrid approach OK with conditions: (1) we countersign via DocuSign now; (2) accept notarized scan for invoicing; (3) customer must mail original within 5 business days. Add this attestation to the Order Form footer: 

"A notarized scanned copy of a manually executed Order Form shall be deemed an original for contract and invoicing purposes."

Priya (Legal): Also, they requested uptime credits in Exhibit B. We should push back to standard SLA credits and offer a short trial credit for the POC only.

Ravi (Finance): With PO BL-90011 and notarized scan we can invoice Net30. If they want the POC credit applied, please confirm the dollar amount on the Order Form.

SignBot: Envelope env_f9b2 created for BioLattice — recipients: BioLattice Contracts, Jon (AE), Priya (Legal). Status: sent.

Maya (Procurement): Please mail originals to: BioLattice Corp, Attn: Vendor Contracts, 210 Innovation Dr, Cambridge, MA 02142. Include cover letter with PO BL-90011.

Jon (AE): I'll overnight the original and attach tracking + the notarized scan when received. Priya/Ravi — I'll add the attestation and the one-time POC credit line to the Order Form before sending. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
